about: King George Co., VA, Will Books A-1 and 1: full second-pass hand review (82 + 91 entries, plus 9 wills split out of 4 entries). Hand-reviewed records, one per will, checked against the original abstract text (orig). Match an existing will by key [vol, pages, auto_testator] as in src/auto_wills.txt. Records with new_will=true are wills the automatic pass had merged into the entry named by split_from; add them as new wills and move the names out of that parent entry. recipients use 'Name (relationship)'; a leading ~ marks an unnamed group. bequests.recipient matches a recipients entry (without ~), an enslaved name (FREED/HIRED rows), or 'sold'. verb is GIVES, LENDS, SOLD, FREED or HIRED.
